$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/samples.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). W2b-4, schema wave 29/33 (B-W2b-212): samples and pre-production gates. The office (factory_runtime) reads and writes through apps/factory-api's modules/sales/samples, sales/sample-decisions and planning/milestones, always with command(). A portal or link session (factory_partner_runtime) reads its own party's sample rounds, swatches and shipments with their decisions, never who asked or decided in the office, the round's internal instructions (@internal) or a cost (the round's charge is a price: readable); it decides by answering the approval request (links-depth.prisma), never by writing these rows. Fit measurements, fit comments and order gates are the office's. The floor reads none (a sample work order is a WorkOrder of kind SAMPLE). No personal data. Nothing is deleted but measurements and comments of an open round, swatches and shipments not sent, and gates neither passed nor overridden (the …_changes_samples_w2b_guards triggers). After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

SampleRound.about: The office requests a sample round, moves its stage, records its decision (its own, or the brand's answer to the approval request), the certification result and certificate, or cancels it; never deleted. The brand (partner) reads its own rounds with their decision, without the creator, the office decider or the internal instructions.

SampleMeasurement.about: The office records the fit measured against the frozen spec per point of measure and size while the round is open (an office session on a tablet too), and removes a wrong row while it is open.

SampleComment.about: The office writes fit comments per point of measure or body area while the round is open, resolves them at any time, and removes one while the round is open.

SampleSwatch.about: The office records a leather or colour swatch, sends it, asks the brand by an approval request and records the decision once; it removes one not yet sent. The brand (partner) reads its own swatches with their decision, without the creator or the office decider.

SampleShipment.about: The office records a round's sample shipments (courier, tracking, sent, received) and removes one not yet sent. The party it goes to or comes from (partner) reads it, without the creator.

OrderGate.about: The office (planning) sets a sales order's pre-production gates, passes them, lets the order start before one (an override by someone who is neither the gate's owner nor its maker, with a reason) and removes a gate neither passed nor overridden. The partner reads none.
